dialogues.en:
"......I was talking to myself. Don't interrupt my
conversation."
dialogues.text:
"......I was talking to myself. Don't interrupt my
conversation."

dialogues.jp: という間に授業が終わった。
dialogues.en:
"Is that the same thing as 'If you answer back to a person
who is taking in their sleep, the person will die'?"
dialogues.text:
"Is that the same thing as 'If you answer back to a person
who is taking in their sleep, the person will die'?"

dialogues.jp:
「環境が変わると１日が過ぎるのが早いよな、
　ほんと……」
dialogues.en: "No, it's not the same."
dialogues.text: "No, it's not the same."

dialogues.jp:
いつものように教科書は机の中にそのままに、
俺は席を立った。
dialogues.en: As usual, I put my school books in my desk and stand up.
dialogues.text: As usual, I put my school books in my desk and stand up.

dialogues.jp: 「帰るか」
dialogues.en: "I'm going home."
dialogues.text: "I'm going home."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「だな」
dialogues.en: "Me, too."
dialogues.text: "Me, too."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「なあ、杉並。適当に楽だけど身体はばっちり
　鍛えられる、そんなクラブはこの学園にあっ
　たっけか？」
dialogues.en:
"Suginami, do you know any clubs in this school that don't
have hard training sessions but where you can build up your
muscles?"
dialogues.text:
"Suginami, do you know any clubs in this school that don't
have hard training sessions but where you can build up your
muscles?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ない」
dialogues.en: "No."
dialogues.text: "No."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「即答かよ。ちっとは考えろ」
dialogues.en: "You didn't even think! Try to think."
dialogues.text: "You didn't even think! Try to think."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「牛丼の牛抜きなみの矛盾だぞ、それは。そも
　そも何だ、急に。ロードオブ帰宅部のお前が」
dialogues.en:
"Do you hear what you're saying? It's like trying to find a
good beef-and-rice bowl without beef. Anyway, why do you
want to join an athletic club? You're like the biggest nerd
in school."
dialogues.text:
"Do you hear what you're saying? It's like trying to find a
good beef-and-rice bowl without beef. Anyway, why do you
want to join an athletic club? You're like the biggest nerd
in school."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「｛かくせい／覚醒｝を｛と／遂｝げてしまってな」
dialogues.en: "I experienced an inner awakening."
dialogues.text: "I experienced an inner awakening."

dialogues.jp: うずうず、という音が横から聞こえてきた。
dialogues.en: I can hear the sound of his curiosity growing inside him.
dialogues.text: I can hear the sound of his curiosity growing inside him.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「で？　どういった覚醒だ？」
dialogues.en: "So? What kind of awakening was it?"
dialogues.text: "So? What kind of awakening was it?"

dialogues.jp:
鉛筆を持っていれば、舌先でぺろりとやりそう
な勢い。
dialogues.en:
He leans towards me so close that he could almost sniff out
my secret.
dialogues.text:
He leans towards me so close that he could almost sniff out
my secret.

dialogues.jp:
「それは、言語なんかでは到底表現不能な概念
　で──」
dialogues.en:
"It's a concept that is way beyond expression by words,
and......"
dialogues.text:
"It's a concept that is way beyond expression by words,
and......"

dialogues.jp: 「……ん？　あ、眞子だ」
dialogues.en: "......? Oh it's Mako."
dialogues.text: "......? Oh it's Mako."

dialogues.jp: 廊下の角をくるっと回る、その後ろ姿が見えた。
dialogues.en: I see her at the corner of the hallway walking away.
dialogues.text: I see her at the corner of the hallway walking away.

dialogues.jp: 「うおーい、眞子」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Mako!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Mako!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ん……？　何だ、朝倉……と、杉並か」
dialogues.en: "What......? Oh, Asakura...... and Suginami."
dialogues.text: "What......? Oh, Asakura...... and Suginami."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「よう。元気してるか、水越」
dialogues.en: "Hi. Hahaha. Long time no see."
dialogues.text: "Hi. Hahaha. Long time no see."

dialogues.jp: だが、眞子は何故か、浮かない顔をしている。
dialogues.en:
Suginami suddenly looks as stiff as a tin soldier. And Mako
looks unhappy for some reason.
dialogues.text:
Suginami suddenly looks as stiff as a tin soldier. And Mako
looks unhappy for some reason.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Sigh..."
dialogues.text: "Sigh..."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「何だよ、眞子。顔色が｛さ／冴｝えないな」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong, Mako? You look down."
dialogues.text: "What's wrong, Mako? You look down."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ん、ちょっと……ね」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, I am......"
dialogues.text: "Yeah, I am......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「尻尾でも生えてきたのか？」
dialogues.en: "Is a tail growing from your ass or something?"
dialogues.text: "Is a tail growing from your ass or something?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「何、意味不明なこと言ってんのよ……」
dialogues.en: "What the fuck are you talking about......?"
dialogues.text: "What the fuck are you talking about......?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「意味不明なら怒るなよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't be so mad. It's not like I called you asshole."
dialogues.text: "Don't be so mad. It's not like I called you asshole."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「例えばだ、誰かから“あすほー”なる意味不
　明の単語を言われたとしても、俺は悔しくも
　何ともないぞ」
dialogues.en:
"I won't get mad even if someone calls me an asshole because
I know I'm not."
dialogues.text:
"I won't get mad even if someone calls me an asshole because
I know I'm not."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ふぁっきん、あすほー」
dialogues.en: "You are a fucking asshole!"
dialogues.text: "You are a fucking asshole!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「何だとうっ！？」
dialogues.en: "What did you say!?"
dialogues.text: "What did you say!?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……やだ、下品なこと言わせないでよ」
dialogues.en: "......Don't make me use dirty words."
dialogues.text: "......Don't make me use dirty words."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ははは。お似合いじゃないか」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha. You and dirty words are perfect for each other."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha. You and dirty words are perfect for each other."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……何ですって？」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「はあ……全く、あんた達と会って、ますます
　疲れちゃったじゃない……」
dialogues.en: "Sigh...... I feel more wrecked now because of you guys."
dialogues.text: "Sigh...... I feel more wrecked now because of you guys."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……おいおい、あんた達って。そのカウント
　に俺も入っているのか？」
dialogues.en: "......Are you talking about me, too?"
dialogues.text: "......Are you talking about me, too?"

dialogues.jp:
怒りがぷしゅっと抜け出て、眞子の身体全体が
縮まったように見える。
dialogues.en:
I can see her anger coming out of her body like steam out of
a boiling pot.
dialogues.text:
I can see her anger coming out of her body like steam out of
a boiling pot.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあね。バイバイ」
dialogues.en: "See you later, guys."
dialogues.text: "See you later, guys."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「おい、眞子。肩落として、らしくないぞ」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong with you, dropping your shoulders like that?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong with you, dropping your shoulders like that?"

dialogues.jp:
背中を向けたままひらひらと手を振り、眞子は
去っていった。
dialogues.en: She waves goodbye without turning around and walks away.
dialogues.text: She waves goodbye without turning around and walks away.

dialogues.jp: 「……何なんだ、あいつは……？」
dialogues.en: "......What was wrong with her......?"
dialogues.text: "......What was wrong with her......?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ふむ、気になるな……」
dialogues.en: "I'm worried......"
dialogues.text: "I'm worried......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そうか？　まあ確かに、変なのが生えてきた
　ら、ミステリーではあるが」
dialogues.en:
"Are you really? If she really is growing a tail on her
butt, then that's a mystery that you'd love."
dialogues.text:
"Are you really? If she really is growing a tail on her
butt, then that's a mystery that you'd love."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「事件の匂いがする」
dialogues.en:
"This is a good opportunity. I'll go talk to her...... So,
see you later, Asakura."
dialogues.text:
"This is a good opportunity. I'll go talk to her...... So,
see you later, Asakura."

dialogues.jp:
眞子に聞かれたら確実に衛星軌道上までブッ飛
ばされそうなことを杉並が言う。

「いや、仮にあったとしてもそれとおまえに、
　何の関係が？」
dialogues.en: He runs off lightly.
dialogues.text: He runs off lightly.

dialogues.jp: タッタッタと軽快に廊下を走り去ってしまった。
dialogues.en: "What do you mean by a good opportunity......?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean by a good opportunity......?"

dialogues.jp: 「調査って……何をどうやって？」
dialogues.en: He is so weird......
dialogues.text: He is so weird......

dialogues.jp: ◆おかしな眞子◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
放課後、杉並と話しながら歩いていると眞子に
出会った。
dialogues.en: It's already the end of the last class.
dialogues.text: It's already the end of the last class.

dialogues.jp:
なんだか珍しく元気がない様子の眞子を、杉並
は調査と称して追って行った。
dialogues.en: "Time really flies by so fast in a different environment."
dialogues.text: "Time really flies by so fast in a different environment."

dialogues.jp: 変なやつ。
dialogues.en:
"It's because you were sleeping in almost allof the classes,
I guess?"
dialogues.text:
"It's because you were sleeping in almost allof the classes,
I guess?"
